data.description: Architect c11 as the source of truth for model token cost. Deliverable: design doc (docs/token-cost-awareness-design.md) covering placement, data model (all-models pricing + per-provider OpenRouter endpoints economics), 24h poller with persistence and stale-serve, and query surface (CLI/socket/events) for operator + Sekhem Prime v2 deck consumption. Commissioned by Sekhem Prime orchestrator; architecture only until operator review.
data.title: Token-cost awareness: model pricing catalog + 24h OpenRouter poller + query surface (architecture)

data.body: Design doc ready for operator review: docs/token-cost-awareness-design.md. Covers placement (Sources/TokenCost/ shared core + app-side DispatchSourceTimer singleton, file-first catalog at ~/Library/Application Support/c11/token-cost/catalog.json), schema-v1 data model normalized to USD/Mtok with static overrides.json for the all-models gap, 24h poller with serve-stale + backoff on the shared OpenRouter key (1 request /models + small watchlist of /endpoints per cycle; throughput/latency percentiles require auth — verified live), query surface (c11 token-cost CLI with app-down fetch-if-stale, tokencost.* socket v2 off-main, optional phase-2 event), and Sekhem Prime v2 consumption with zero v1 dependency. Recommended rollout: 3 phases, phase 1 (core + CLI) alone unblocks Sekhem v2. 5 open questions flagged for the operator in §6.

data.reason: Review docs/token-cost-awareness-design.md (open in markdown surface 92) and answer the 5 open questions in §6; no implementation until you approve

data.note: Operator answered all 5 open questions in interview; decisions recorded in doc §6

data.body: Interview decisions locked into docs/token-cost-awareness-design.md §6: (1) watchlist = Sekhem route models + Anthropic/OpenAI daily drivers, with native-API pricing satisfied by the verified OpenRouter mirror; (2) key via OPENROUTER_API_KEY env var only; (3) tokencost.refreshed event ships in phase 2, app-emitted only; (4) CLI verb is c11 token-cost, no alias; (5) fuzzy matching for humans with ambiguity-errors, exact ids echoed in --json. Design complete — phase 1 implementation awaits explicit operator go-ahead (lattice-orchestrator flow).
